Multiple Drug and Gold Seizures Reported Across India

Authorities across India have reported significant seizures of contraband and illegal substances in recent operations. In Assam, gold worth ₹54 crore was recovered, leading to one arrest and suspicion of an international network. Meanwhile, police in Odisha claimed to have seized ₹2,106 crore worth of cannabis and ₹225 crore of hash oil, destroying vast illegal cultivation and arresting 3,500 individuals. Other reports detail the destruction of over a quintal of seized cannabis in Faridabad and arrests of smugglers with opium and cannabis in Panipat and Jhajjar.
